name: Necropolis
title: Necropolis
summary: An ancient burial ground at 49.0S 54.3W: two small grass-roofed stone bunkers (7.8 m, 4 m tall; one leads down into the catacombs with the Staff of the Nomads chest) on a terrace at z 40 among a few trees, with a candle shrine; the hill rises to 90 m behind it and a Life Stone stands 258 m to the south-east.

site.name: Necropolis
site.notes: Derived teleport 36 m east-south-east of the bunkers on the burial terrace (the gazetteer Life Stone entry is 258 m away and 28 m lower).

shots.standingOrder: Arc 30 degrees clockwise 55 m south-west of the two burial bunkers on their terrace, looking down 38 degrees with the sun behind; keep 6 m from the trees.
shots.notes: Slow 30 deg arc 55 m out, looking down 38 deg on the two grass-roofed burial bunkers on their terrace among a few trees, the hill rising behind; afternoon sun behind the lens. The steep angle clears the 8 m trees around the bunkers.
